proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Displayed signs and normalizing factors require correction

Gaussian tests use independent standard normal variables: mean zero, variance one, strictly subgaussian, bounded density, T_infinity=0. Tilt parameter h=1, test-transform parameter t=0 where specified. Periodic example uses P=(1-4sin^2 t)^2 sin^4 t, c=1/(2B), B=sum |a_k| exp(k^2/2), yielding density p=q*phi with 1/2<=q<=3/2, mean zero and variance one. Convolution test uses c0=0,c1=sqrt(3)/2,c2=1/2 and independent standard normals; c1^2+c2^2=1.
